name: points
description: One row per effective point slot (played points and point penalties) in log order, from the fold. Exported as points.csv (P1-11) and inside a Share Pack.

columns.name: point_id
columns.description: Event id of the effective point event.

columns.name: set_number
columns.description: 1-based; empty when the point is undetermined or after the match end.

columns.name: game_number
columns.description: 1-based match game; a set tie-break counts as one game.

columns.name: server
columns.description: Display name of the rules-derived server.

columns.name: receiver
columns.description: Display name; empty in doubles when the No-Ad side was not recorded.

columns.name: score_before
columns.description: Server first, language-neutral: 30-15, 40-40 (deuce or No-Ad deciding point), AD-40, 40-AD; tie-break counts like 3-2.

columns.name: games_before
columns.description: Games in the current set, side A first, e.g. 4-3.

columns.name: sets_before
columns.description: Sets won, side A first, e.g. 1-0.

columns.name: winner_side
columns.description: Empty when the winner is unknown.

columns.name: winner
columns.description: Display name(s) of the winning side joined with ' / '.

columns.name: rally_length
columns.description: Serve counts; the final error does not.

columns.name: determined
columns.description: False after an unknown winner: the score is provisional and not derived.
